data: Which of the following represents the trend of the JOINT model in the right graph (b)?

The trend of the JOINT model in the right graph (b) is represented by the horizontal lines. These lines correspond to the JOINT model's performance across different training pair counts. The red line represents the De→En direction, while the blue line represents the En→De direction. Both lines remain relatively flat, indicating that the JOINT model's performance does not significantly improve with increasing training pairs.
